launcher.h1: All your TrackMania in one window
launcher.lead: Start any installed game, add mods in one click, join servers and events. Files come from the authors and are checked against their SHA-256 before they load.
launcher.f1: TMLoader mods with their dependencies; updates when the author ships one.
launcher.f2: Every download is compared with the checksum the mod server publishes.
launcher.f3: Live servers with player counts, events in your time zone, join from the list.
authors.lead: You keep hosting your files. TM Horizon reads your newest version from where you publish it and lists it next to the others.
authors.loginAfter: After signing in you land in the developer portal: paste your GitHub repository or TMLoader server, check the preview and publish. No tokens or keys needed.
authors.s1: Publish releases on GitHub, or run a TMLoader mod server. Nothing is uploaded here.
authors.s2: With GitHub or Discord, to prove the repository or server is yours.
authors.s3: Paste the repository or mod server URL, pick games and a category.
authors.s4: A person looks at a new author once. After that, new versions go through the checks.

addserver.title: Add your server
addserver.desc: Put your TrackMania server on the TM Horizon list. Log in and it is listed at once.
addserver.lead: Players see your server with live player counts in the launcher. With a login your server is checked and listed at once. Without one, a person looks at the entry first.
addserver.addressNote: Public IP address or name with port, for example 1.2.3.4:2350. The server login alone is not enough.
addserver.name: Server name
addserver.contactNote: Discord name or e-mail. Only the reviewers see it; the approval and your announce token are sent here.
addserver.sent: Received. We will contact you after the review.
addserver.failed: Could not send. Please try again later.
addserver.exists: This server is already listed or waiting for review.
addserver.badAddress: That address is not valid. Use ip:port or host:port.
addserver.private: The address must be reachable from the internet (no private or local addresses).
addserver.limit: Too many entries from this connection or account. Try again later.
addserver.invalid: Please check the fields: name 3 to 80 characters, contact, homepage with https.
addserver.hubOff: The hub is not online yet, so entries cannot be sent from this page.
addserver.how1: Log in with Discord or GitHub (optional) and fill in the form.
addserver.how2: With a login, the hub asks your server once and lists it at once if it answers. Without, a person checks the entry and approves it.
addserver.how3: The launcher shows your server and asks it directly for players and map. With the XAseco plugin your server can also announce itself every 5 minutes.
addserver.privacy: The hub connects to your server only when a logged-in person checks or sends it, then every 6 hours to see if it is online (one connection, 3 seconds, game port only). We store a hash of the sender's IP address against abuse. The server address is public server data. The contact is only used for the review.
addserver.contactNoteUser: Optional. Only needed if this is your server. Only the reviewers see it.
addserver.loginHint: Log in and the hub asks your server right away. If it answers as the chosen game, it is listed without a review.
addserver.nameAuto: Optional. The name is taken from the server.
addserver.noAnswer: No answer from the game port. Is the server running and the TCP port open?
addserver.badPort: The game port must be 1024 or higher.
addserver.busy: Many checks right now. Try again in a minute.
addserver.ownerNote: Needs a contact. You prove it with a code in the server name or comment; until then it is shown as suggested by the community.
addserver.listedSuggested: The server is listed as suggested by the community. Its operator can claim it.
addserver.pendingNoAnswer: The server did not answer, so a person will look at it.
addserver.pendingPassword: The server has a password. It is listed only if you say it is your server.
addserver.claimCode: Your code: {code}. Put it into the server name or comment, then press the button. It is valid for 30 minutes and works once. You can remove it afterwards.
addserver.claimNotFound: The code is not in the server name or comment yet. It can take a moment until the server shows the change.
addserver.claimExpired: The code expired or was used. Send the form again or ask for a new code.
addserver.needLogin: Log in first to check a server.
dev.meta: Documentation for people who build mods, plugins and tools for the old Trackmania games and TM Horizon.
dev.lead: You decide how far to go. Each level needs a bit more from you and gives players a bit more in TM Horizon.
dev.col.get: What then works in TM Horizon
dev.l0.get: The catalog links to your page. Players find the mod, but nothing is installed for them.
dev.l1.do: Publish a release on GitHub or a TMLoader server and claim the project with your login.
dev.l1.get: One-click install, update and undo in the launcher.
dev.l2.do: Add metadata and a showcase.json to your repository.
dev.l2.get: Compatibility per game, the online-safe badge, hotkeys, companion links and your own showcase page.
dev.l3a.do: Write a Horizon plugin (native DLL, small C interface).
dev.l3a.get: A tab in the game menu, panels, game events, save_replay, notifications, hiding from captures, safe mode and the online gate.
dev.l3b.get: Runs in all four legacy games, no DLL to build.
dev.l4.do: Use the porting kit in your native mod (hz_port.h).
dev.l4.get: One source for several games, built per game by CI.
dev.pieces.lead: The launcher installs mods from the hub into the game. In the game, a loader starts the Horizon Client, and the host runs plugins and scripts.
dev.d.alt: Diagram: authors publish to the hub, the hub feeds the launcher, the launcher installs into the game, where a loader starts the Horizon Client, which runs plugins, scripts and Node Explorer. Other mods like TMVS run next to it.
dev.d.game: The game on the player's PC
dev.d.hostSub: in-game client: menu, hotkeys, log, game events
dev.d.otherSub: no plugin needed, they keep working
dev.docs.note: The documentation itself is in English.
dev.abi: Horizon Client ABI 1.3 (notifications, the launcher bridge) and Horizon Scripts are still being consolidated and are not released yet. Details can change.
dev.editNote: The repositories are private for now. The link works once they are public.
